path.style: fill: none; stroke: #6e6e6e; stroke-width: 1.3; stroke-linecap: round

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d55e00

path.style: fill: #0072b2; opacity: 0.11; stroke: #0072b2; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: A river people and fish can live in. Air that does not shorten a life.

path.style: fill: #0072b2; opacity: 0.195; stroke: #0072b2; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: "Requisite to protect public health with an adequate margin of safety." A sentence, not a number.

path.style: fill: #56b4e9; opacity: 0.28; stroke: #56b4e9; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: An ambient standard, an effluent limit, a listing threshold. The first real proxy.

path.style: fill: #e69f00; opacity: 0.365; stroke: #e69f00; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Facility limits, averaging periods, applicability cutoffs, netting baselines, exclusions.

path.style: fill: #d55e00; opacity: 0.45; stroke: #d55e00; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Emission factors, test methods, monitor downtime allowances, substitute data.

path.style: fill: #d55e00; opacity: 0.535; stroke: #d55e00; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: What actually gets optimised. The only layer an automated system ever sees.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #d55e00
font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #d55e00
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Environmental law, read as a reward function. An optimiser never sees the top layer.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e
font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Every descent down this stack was necessary and every one was fought over: the substitutions are what made the law enforceable,

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: and each was adjudicated by industry lawyers and agency lawyers arguing against each other. But every substitution opens a space

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: between satisfying the number and achieving the intent, and a capable optimiser is precisely a machine for finding that space. No

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: rule is broken at any layer. Nothing in the system is capable of noticing. The gap is a product of the design, not an abuse of it.
